Name: Zenith Farm
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[font=Courier New][size=4][color=#cc4125]✿[/color][b] [/b][b]features[/b][/size][/font]

[b]⋆[/b] tillable grass, seasonal forage, berry bushes, renewable hardwood
[b]⋆[/b] panoramic background that changes with seasons, weather, time of day, etc
[b]⋆[/b] use the warp totem next to the bus stop entry to warp straight to the house


[font=Courier New][size=4][b][b][font=Courier New][size=4][color=#e69138]✿[/color] [/size][/font][/b]options[/b][/size][/font]
[i][size=1]to customise this farm, use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]generic mod config menu[/url] or edit the config.json file in the [CP] Zenith Farm folder[/size][/i]

⋆ enable/disable spring 1 debris
⋆ enable/disable decorations
⋆ enable/disable stone bridges
⋆ enable/disable minecart shortcuts
⋆ rename the minecart destinations


[font=Courier New][size=4][b][b][font=Courier New][size=4][color=#f1c232]✿[/color] [/size][/font][/b]requirements[/b][/size][/font]

[b]⋆ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]
⋆ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]farm type manager[/url][/b]
[b]⋆[/b] [url=https://nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]daisyniko's tilesheets[/url]


[font=Courier New][size=4][font=Courier New][size=4][color=#6aa84f]✿[/color] [/size][/font][b]installation[/b][/size][/font]

[b][size=1]1.[/size][/b] install all required mods then download this mod
[b][size=1]2.[/size][/b] extract [i][u]both[/u] [/i]folders from the zip to Stardew Valley/Mods
[b][size=1]3.[/size][/b] run the game with smapi to play~
